steps.name: show-furniture
steps.eval: (() => { const v=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup="menu"]')].find(x=>/^\s*View/.test(x.textContent||'')); if(v && v.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') v.click(); const fb=document.querySelector("button[title^='Show furniture footprints']"); if(fb && fb.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true') fb.click(); })()

steps.name: record-before
steps.eval: (() => { const p=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; window.__w0 = p.walls.map(w=>({id:w.id,sx:w.start[0],sz:w.start[1],ex:w.end[0],ey:w.end[1]})); window.__bounds = (function(){ let mx=p.extent[0]; for(const w of p.walls){mx=Math.max(mx,w.start[0],w.end[0]);} for(const r of p.rooms){mx=Math.max(mx, r.origin[0]+r.width);} return mx; })(); window.__axis = window.__bounds/2; window.__nItems = window.__store.getState().items.length; })()

steps.name: assert-reflected
steps.eval: (() => { const p=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const axis=window.__axis; for(const b of window.__w0){ const w=p.walls.find(x=>x.id===b.id); if(!w) throw new Error('wall gone: '+b.id); const exSX=2*axis-b.sx; if(Math.abs(w.start[0]-exSX)>1e-6) throw new Error('start.x not reflected '+b.id+': '+w.start[0]+' vs '+exSX); if(Math.abs(w.start[1]-b.sz)>1e-9) throw new Error('start.z changed '+b.id); } if(window.__store.getState().items.length!==window.__nItems) throw new Error('item count changed'); return 'reflected '+window.__w0.length+' walls about x='+axis.toFixed(2); })()

steps.name: assert-identity
steps.eval: (() => { const p=window.__store.getState().floorPlan; for(const b of window.__w0){ const w=p.walls.find(x=>x.id===b.id); if(Math.abs(w.start[0]-b.sx)>1e-6) throw new Error('double-mirror NOT identity '+b.id+': '+w.start[0]+' vs '+b.sx); } return 'double-mirror about same axis = identity over '+window.__w0.length+' walls'; })()
